'''Chess''' was a board game played throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

A more advanced version known as [[Holochess/Legends|holochess]] was derived from the game, and it was most likely related to similar strategy games like [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]].

The [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] were noted throughout the galaxy as master chess players. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] had a chess set onboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] which he occasionally enjoyed, and he was once beaten soundly at the game by the diminutive droid [[Blue Max]].<ref name="HS">[[Han Solo at Stars' End (comic strip)|''Han Solo at Stars' End'' comic]]</ref> The [[Slith]] known as [[Sssiii]] entertained visitors to the [[Galactic Circus]] by playing chess.<ref name="CB">{{CasusBelliCite|115|Le facteur X}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Chess in the Star Wars galaxy appears to be the same game as chess on the planet Earth. Real world chess also inspired the game of [[Dejarik/Legends|Dejarik]].
